body:
This was specialised for each `RenderingDeviceDriver`, as Metal can only map shared textures that are:

* 2D,
* 1 mipmap level
* 1 array length
* 1 sample
* not compressed or depth
One of the cases has a blank line and the other doesn't, but I don't really see a rationale as to why. I would make both cases consistent here (either have a line break in both or in neither).
Original was that way too, but I agree. Will push a change.
